$comment: Reviewed computed require/import call sites in the Next.js server core (the literal closure of `next` and `next/dist/server/lib/start-server`). The compiled standalone executable's disk-closure scan cannot follow these. Each reason says why the site cannot load a second instance of a module the executable bundles. A Next upgrade that changes this set fails standalone-computed-requires.test.ts: re-review the changed sites before updating this file.

dist/export/helpers/create-incremental-c.reason: Imports the configured cacheHandler/cacheHandlers by path. The compile makes every configured handler a disk-closure root and refuses one outside the standalone tree, so the handler and what it imports stay on disk as a single instance.

dist/server/config.js.reason: Loads next.config.* and the configured adapterPath by path. In a standalone build the config is inlined into server.js (__NEXT_PRIVATE_STANDALONE_CONFIG), so this runs only if a config file is loaded at runtime. The adapter is build-time only.

dist/server/lib/module-loader/node-modul.reason: Generic `require(id)` used to load page and route modules from .next/server by path. These are disk-loaded build output, in the disk closure.

dist/server/lib/render-server.js.reason: Imports the configured cache handler by path, as create-incremental-cache does. Handlers are disk-closure roots (see standaloneCacheHandlerFiles), so they stay single-instance.

dist/server/lib/router-utils/instrumenta.reason: Requires the built instrumentation hook (.next/server/instrumentation.js) by path. Build output under .next/server, scanned as a disk-closure root.

dist/server/next-server.js.reason: Requires build manifests and .next/server/{middleware,functions-config-manifest} by path, and imports page modules. All build output under .next, which is disk-loaded and in the disk closure.

dist/server/next.js.reason: Requires the serialized required-server-files config under distDir by path: build output (JSON), no module identity involved.

dist/server/og/image-response.js.reason: `import(NEXT_RUNTIME === 'edge' ? '<edge og>' : '<node og>')`: a ternary of two literals. The compile defines NEXT_RUNTIME='nodejs', so the bundler resolves it statically. og is reached from route chunks, which puts it in the disk closure.

dist/server/require.js.reason: `require(pagePath)`: loads the page/route module from .next/server. Build output, in the disk closure.

dist/server/route-matcher-providers/help.reason: Requires build manifests (JSON) under .next by path. No module identity involved.

dist/server/route-modules/route-module.j.reason: dynamicImportEsmDefault(id) for route userland modules under .next/server. Build output, in the disk closure.

dist/telemetry/events/plugins.js.reason: Reads the project's package.json for telemetry. JSON, no module identity involved.

dist/telemetry/events/swc-load-failure.j.reason: Reads SWC package.json versions after a SWC load failure (build/dev telemetry). JSON, and not reached on the production request path.
